question.prompt: The eighth grade class at Lincoln Middle School has \(93\) students. Each student takes a math class or a foreign language class or both. There are \(70\) eighth graders taking a math class, and there are \(54\) eighth graders taking a foreign language class. How many eighth graders take only a math class and not a foreign language class?

solutions.explanation:
Every student takes at least one of the two subjects. Therefore anyone who does not take a foreign language must take math, and belongs to exactly the group being asked for.

Of the \(93\) students, \(54\) take a foreign language. The others number

\[
93-54=\boxed{39},
\]

choice \(\boxed{\text{D}}\). Counting the complement avoids needing to calculate the overlap first.
solutions.title: Count the complement of foreign-language students
